headline: As of 2026-10-28: 40,471,571 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 48 of 50 states, D+10.1 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 40,471,571 early/mail ballots cast so far across 48 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+10.1 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (5,808,863), California (4,101,720), Florida (3,887,297).
